segments.caption: Arete, daughter of Rhexenor, after many trials I come to your knees, and to your king, and to all these feasters — may the gods give you long joy. For me, ask only this: grant me convoy to my own country, for I have suffered long, far from everyone I love.

segments.caption: Alcinous, this is not well, and it does not befit you: a stranger sitting in the ashes of your hearth. Raise him up, seat him on a silver-studded chair, and let the herald mix wine, for Zeus himself walks with suppliants.
